data.name: Settings_FlyoutCompactDescription
data.value: Shrinks the flyout to about the size of the taskbar bars: one line per row. Double-clicking the flyout switches too.

data.name: Settings_FlyoutClickThroughDescription
data.value: Passes mouse input on the flyout to the window behind it. Hold Ctrl to use the flyout itself.

data.name: Settings_TaskbarBarClickThroughDescription
data.value: Passes mouse input on the bars to the taskbar or full-screen app under them. Hold Ctrl to click or drag them.

data.name: Settings_WeeklyNotificationsDescription
data.value: Also notifies you when weekly usage reaches the same percentages, and when the weekly window resets.

data.name: Settings_ResetTimeDescription
data.value: Show a reset as the time left until it, or as the time of day it happens.

data.name: Settings_TrayIconDescription
data.value: What the tray icon shows. In the double ring, the outer ring is the session and the inner one the week.

data.name: Settings_TestConnectionToolTip
data.value: Checks that usage can be read, the same way regular updates do (using about 10 tokens unless “Don't consume usage” is on).

data.name: Settings_TestConnectionDescription
data.value: Checks that usage can be read, the same way regular updates do.

data.name: Settings_NotificationsDescription
data.value: Notifies you when session usage reaches the percentages below, and when the session window resets.

data.name: Settings_LaunchAtLoginDescription
data.value: Starts automatically when you sign in to Windows.

data.name: Settings_ShowOnStartupDescription
data.value: Opens the window when Usagi starts. Off, it starts with only the taskbar bars and the tray icon.

data.name: Settings_AlwaysOnTopDescription
data.value: Keeps the flyout above other windows.

data.name: Settings_TaskbarBarOnlyOnStartup
data.value: Start with only the taskbar bars

data.name: Settings_TaskbarBarOnlyOnStartupDescription
data.value: Doesn't open the window when Usagi starts: just the taskbar bars and the tray icon. The same setting as "Open the window at startup" under Window.

data.name: Settings_TaskbarBarDescription
data.value: Keeps the usage bars on the taskbar, left of the notification area. Click them to open the flyout; drag them sideways to move them.

data.name: Settings_TaskbarBarDisplayDescription
data.value: {0} × {1}, {2}. The slider shifts the bars, like dragging them on the taskbar.

data.name: Settings_TaskbarBarOffsetToolTip
data.value: Shifts the bars left (negative) or right (positive) of their automatic place

data.name: Settings_TaskbarBarOverFullScreenDescription
data.value: Keeps the bars visible, on a dark backdrop, while a full-screen game or video covers the taskbar.

data.name: Settings_ThresholdsDescription
data.value: Notifies you when usage reaches these percentages. You can add up to {0}.

data.name: Settings_MascotAnimationDescription
data.value: Subtle moves a little when its face changes and once a minute. Lively keeps moving all the time.

data.name: Settings_MascotWakesOnResetDescription
data.value: When a reset comes while it's asleep with the usage spent, it stretches before it gets up.

data.name: Settings_MascotStartlesOnJumpDescription
data.value: Gives a start when the session's usage is 10 points or more up on the last time it was fetched.

data.name: Settings_MascotHoldsSign
data.value: Hold up a sign at a threshold

data.name: Settings_MascotHoldsSignDescription
data.value: Holds up a sign with the percentage over its head when the session's usage passes one of the notification thresholds (75% and so on).

data.name: Settings_MascotFollowsCursorDescription
data.value: Turns its eyes to the cursor while that's nearby. Not while it's worried or asleep.

data.name: Settings_MascotBodyGaugeDescription
data.value: Fades the creature from the top down by as much of the session as is used. Pick how the faded part is drawn.

data.name: Settings_MascotMoodSourceDescription
data.value: Pick which usage sets the creature's mood.

data.name: Settings_MascotIdleActsDescription
data.value: While there's usage to spare, every few minutes it does something of its own: stretches, reads a book, skips rope. In the morning, at lunchtime and at night it does what suits the hour.

data.name: Settings_MascotCarrotDescription
data.value: Lays a carrot beside the creature, which eats it down as the session is used up: what's left of the carrot is what's left of the session.

data.name: Settings_MascotBunnyEarsDescription
data.value: Puts a headband of rabbit ears on the creature. It slips further out of place as the usage climbs.

data.name: Settings_ScaleDescription
data.value: Scales the whole flyout. Dragging its edges changes the same setting.

data.name: Settings_OpacityDescription
data.value: Lower values let what's behind the flyout show through.
